steps: Open the first link. Pick your workspace and click Create.
In the new app, if a Model Context Protocol (MCP) switch is off, turn it on. It is under Agents & AI Apps.
Open Basic Information and copy the Client ID and Client Secret. Enter them here.
Vyre then prints a Slack address. Open it and click Allow. Slack sends your browser to a page that cannot load; that is expected. Copy the full address from the browser bar and paste it here.

presets.label: Zoom
presets.who: Zoom accounts that can make apps (an account admin or a developer role). You make one small app first.

oauth.help: Zoom's own hosted server takes only an app you make in your Zoom account.

steps: Sign in at marketplace.zoom.us. Click Develop, then Build App, choose General App, and click Create.
On Basic Information, keep the management type User-managed. Under OAuth, set the OAuth redirect URL and the OAuth allow list to {redirect} .
Copy the development Client ID and Client Secret shown on that page. Enter them here.

On the Scopes page click Add Scopes and add: meeting:read:search, meeting:read:assets, meeting:write:meeting, meeting:update:meeting, cloud_recording:read:list_user_recordings, cloud_recording:read:content.
Open Local Test and click Add App Now to allow it on your own account. Then finish the sign-in here.

presets.note: Zoom's docs say loopback redirects work for PKCE apps; a real run confirms it for a development-mode app.

presets.label: Microsoft 365 mail and calendar
presets.who: Anyone with an Outlook.com, Hotmail, work or school account. You register one small app in Microsoft Entra first; it takes a few minutes.

api.use: Ask your agent to use vault.request with the credential microsoft against https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0: GET /me/messages, POST /me/sendMail, GET /me/calendarView, POST /me/events. Reads run; sending mail waits for your approval unless you asked for it.

oauth.help: Microsoft has no hosted server for mail an individual can use, so Vyre signs in with an app you register yourself. No client secret is needed.

steps: Open the link and sign in. Click New registration.

Name it Vyre. Under Supported account types choose Any Entra ID Tenant + Personal Microsoft accounts. Under Redirect URI choose Mobile and desktop applications and enter http://localhost . Click Register.
Copy the Application (client) ID from the page that opens. Enter it here. Leave the secret empty.
Still in the app, open Authentication, then Advanced settings, set Allow public client flows to Yes, and Save.
Open API permissions, click Add a permission, choose Microsoft Graph, then Delegated permissions, and add Mail.ReadWrite, Mail.Send, Calendars.ReadWrite, offline_access and User.Read.
Vyre prints a Microsoft address. Open it, sign in and click Accept. Your browser then shows a page that cannot load; copy the full address from the browser bar and paste it here.

presets.note: A personal Microsoft account with no Azure sign-up may need a free Azure account before the Entra portal opens (unconfirmed).

presets.label: Google personal (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)
presets.who: Anyone with a Google account, including personal Gmail. You make a Google Cloud OAuth client first.

api.use: Ask your agent to use vault.request with the credential google-personal: GET https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages, GET https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events, GET https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files. Reads run; sending mail waits for your approval unless you asked for it.

oauth.help: Google's hosted Workspace server does not take personal accounts, so Vyre signs in with an OAuth client you make in your own Google Cloud project.

links.label: Turn on the Google Calendar API
Turn on the Google Drive API

steps: Make a Cloud project and turn on the three APIs with the links.
Set up the OAuth consent screen as External, and add your own address as a test user.

Publish the app: on the consent screen click Publish app, so its status is In production. Do this, or Google ends your sign-in every 7 days. Unverified is fine for one person; Google shows a warning you click through.
Open Credentials, click Create credentials, OAuth client ID, and choose Desktop app.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret and enter them here.
Vyre prints a Google address. Open it, choose your account, click Advanced and Go to Vyre if Google warns, then Allow.

presets.note: In Testing status Google ends a sign-in after 7 days for these scopes. In production (unverified) it does not, and a sign-in lasts until you revoke it, change your password, or leave it unused six months.

Reads run; posting waits for your approval unless you asked for it.
